references.text: The southern border is described in detail, including the Brook of Egypt as a boundary marker
Joshua's description of Judah's southern border also mentions the Brook of Egypt as a boundary point
Judah's border extends to the Mediterranean Sea (the great sea), the same sea mentioned here
God's promise to Abraham of the land from the River of Egypt, which defines the southern border
Solomon's kingdom extended from Lebo-Hamath to the Brook of Egypt, fulfilling the boundary promise
The Brook of Egypt is mentioned as a border for Egyptian territory
The prophecy about gathering from the Euphrates to the Brook of Egypt refers to the same border area
Ezekiel's vision of the land's future borders includes the brook near Egypt
The southern border in Ezekiel's future vision extends to the Brook of Egypt
